paragraphs: The S-Type 3.0 V6 uses the AJ-V6 — a 3.0-litre V6 petrol. It was fitted from 1999 to 2008 across the X200 generation. It sits above the 2.5 V6 as the mid-range petrol option in the S-Type lineup. The S-Type 3.0 V6 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0L Petrol engine fitted to the S-Type 3.0 V6 — X200 (1999–2008).

compatibility.intro: The S-Type 3.0 V6 uses a single engine family, the AJ-V6, across all generations (X200). Because the engine code is consistent across the production run, there’s no risk of a mid-generation engine change that affects fitment — but we still confirm your exact car by registration before quoting to ensure ancillaries and ECU specifications match your specific build.
